text:
maria: heads up — after last night's rolling upgrade of nvidia-container-toolkit from 1.14 -> 1.15, about 6 nodes in us-west are failing to start GPU containers. Error shows libnvidia-ml / libcuda not visible inside the container even though host bind exists. Cos-based nodes hit first. :eyes:

raj: saw a tiny spike in staging earlier this morning, thought it was flakiness. looks like mount propagation/symlink handling changed in the toolkit.

sam: repro'd on a k8s node: host has /usr/lib/nvidia-525/libnvidia-ml.so.1 symlinked, but container path resolves to nothing. quick log:
```
docker run --rm --gpus all ubuntu:22.04 sh -c 'ldconfig -p | grep nvidia || true'
ldconfig: file /etc/ld.so.cache is truncated
/usr/bin/nvidia-smi: error while loading shared libraries: libnvidia-ml.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
```

elaine: infra-oncall started a partial rollback of toolkit on the most fragile node pool. we'll hold further rollouts.

infra-oncall: rollback queued for the rest of us-west GPU pools at 02:00 UTC. can someone script a canary that checks for the symlink and a quick `nvidia-smi` exit code pre/post rollout?

raj: quick canary command I used:
```sh
if nsenter -t 1 -m -- ls /host/usr/lib | grep -q nvidia; then echo OK; else echo MISSING; fi
```

sam: temporary runtime workaround that worked for a few pods was an initContainer that copies resolved libs into the container image path (ugly but fast):
```yaml
initContainers:
- name: copy-nvidia-libs
  image: busybox:1.36
  command: ["sh", "-c", "mkdir -p /usr/local/lib && cp -L /host/usr/lib/nvidia-* /usr/local/lib && ldconfig"]
  volumeMounts:
  - name: host-lib
    mountPath: /host/usr/lib
```
Note: this requires mount access to the host libs and is only usable for non-sensitive workloads.

deploy-bot: deploy record updated: toolkit-1.15 rollout paused for us-west GPU pools by @elaine (reason: runtime lib visibility failures).

vendor-nvidia: we're looking into potential symlink normalization changes in toolkit 1.15 that can interact poorly with some distro mount namespaces (COS, Rocky). initial hypothesis: rbind -> bind propagation differences + driver package layout changes across driver versions (525 vs 535). collecting repros.

luke: cost note — if we evacuate affected jobs to other regions or to dedicated reserved pools, expect temporary committed compute adjustments and cross-region egress. finance FYI.

elaine: action items:
- infra: finish rollback tonight to 1.14 for affected pools (in progress).
- eng-runtime: add the canary script and a preflight that runs `nvidia-smi` at pod admission.
- infra-oncall: schedule a full audit of node images for symlink layout.
- vendor-nvidia: share root cause and fix timeline.

maria: thanks — please post updates here. if someone can own a short runbook for the initContainer workaround (pros/cons + when to use) that'd be helpful. :thumbsup:
